brief.subject: Volcano erupting with lava fountain and ash cloud
brief.wan_prompt: A single bold volcano silhouette erupting on a pure black background, bright white-hot lava fountain bursting upward from the crater, thick glowing lava streams flowing down the slopes, one large billowing ash cloud rising, high contrast white-on-black shapes, thick clean outlines, simple readable upward motion, flat 2D silhouette style, no texture, no text, minimal detail, centered composition
brief.negative_prompt: color, texture, gradients, background scenery, text, watermark, photorealism, small details, multiple volcanoes, people, buildings, camera shake
brief.notes: The bright lava fountain and single volcano silhouette give bold high-contrast shapes with clear upward motion that stay legible on a 1bpp green MEMS projection.

review.subject_seen: erupting volcano with a billowing ash cloud rising from the crater and lava streams running down the slopes
review.summary: The volcano silhouette with a rising ash cloud and downward lava flows is clearly recognizable as a dramatic volcanic eruption.
